dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp contrast transition from the dark charcoal base coat (exterior) to the light-gray annular lines (interior of the edge). The largest central structure shows a fragmented upper arc, while a posterior 'O' shape maintains a continuous perimeter with a narrower line width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity light-gray flecks scattered primarily in the posterior-lateral region between the larger macro-annuli. These flecks are solid pixel clusters lacking internal gradients and vary slightly in size and orientation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The longest leg of the triangle connects the anterior-most and posterior-most centroids, with an internal angle at the posterior vertex of approximately 130 degrees.
